page.home: Rain all week. Coffee all week.

import_vat_estimate: Import VAT in {country} is due on delivery: about {amount}. The carrier's fee and the EU handling fee come on top.
vat_excise_and_fees: Danish VAT, coffee excise and fees are due on delivery.
roast.label: Roast: {roast}, on a scale of seven from light to dark
home.lede: Roasted in Bergen. Morning roast is
home.gear.title: Two things to brew with
home.gear.lede: A grinder for the beans and a kettle for the water. The grinder carries a 24-month warranty, the kettle 12.
home.window.title: The counter in Bergen
home.window.lede: The roastery has a counter in the city, with its own till. It is the warm side of the shop: come in out of the rain.
home.window.hours: Monday to Saturday. Closed on Sundays.
home.window.loose: Dark espresso by the gram, weighed out as you ask.
home.window.club: The counter keeps a club of its own. Ask at the till.
home.money.title: What the price means where you are
home.money.lede: Every price comes from the shop, in your currency, with the VAT said plainly. Every order is charged in Norwegian kroner. You check out as a guest, and a private link follows your order.
home.money.SE: Prices in kronor, approximately. No Norwegian VAT: Swedish import VAT is due on delivery, and checkout shows an estimate.
home.money.DK: Prices in kroner, approximately. No Norwegian VAT: Danish VAT, coffee excise and fees are due on delivery.
home.money.FI: Prices in euros, approximately. No Norwegian VAT: Finnish import VAT is due on delivery, and checkout shows an estimate.
counter.closed_today: The counter is closed today, as on every Sunday
shop.lede: Beans roasted in Bergen and the gear to brew them. Prices in {currency}
shop.empty: Nothing on this shelf right now.
product.crumbs: Where this is in the shop
product.soon_body: It has no price yet, so it cannot be ordered. It will be here when it does.
product.unknown.title: There is no such product.
product.unknown.body: The link may be old, or the product gone from the shop.
qty.label: Quantity
cart.empty.title: Your bag is empty.
cart.empty.body: Nothing in it yet. Morning roast is a good place to start.
cart.stray: Not for sale right now. Remove it to check out.
cart.blocked: Change what is short, or remove what is not for sale, before you check out.
totals.approx: Amounts in your currency are approximate, at a fixed rate. The order is charged in Norwegian kroner.
totals.import_vat_unknown: Import VAT is due on delivery. We cannot estimate it for this bag today.
checkout.lede: As a guest: no account, no password. Choose your country first, so the prices and the VAT are right.
checkout.empty: There is nothing to check out. Put something in your bag first.
checkout.country_hint: The country sets the currency and how VAT is handled.
checkout.contact_hint: Used for this order only. You do not need an account.
checkout.field.name: Full name
checkout.hint.email: For the order's news, nothing else.
checkout.error.email: This does not look like an e-mail address.
checkout.then: Next comes a test payment. No money moves.
checkout.changed.title: The price has changed.
checkout.changed.body: Since you opened the bag, the shop's price moved. The total is now
checkout.changed.accept: Place the order at the new total
checkout.stock.title: Not enough on the shelf.
pay.title: A test payment. No money moves.
pay.lede: This shop has no real payments yet. Choose what the test bank should do.
pay.explain: No card is asked for and nothing is charged. Approve pays the order; decline and outage show what happens when a payment fails.
pay.declined.title: The payment was declined.
pay.declined.body: Nothing was charged and your order is kept. Try again whenever you are ready.
pay.down.title: The payment service did not answer.
pay.down.body: Nothing was charged and your order is kept.
pay.done.title: This order is paid.
pay.done.body: There is nothing left to pay.
order.says.placed: The order is placed and waits for its payment.
order.says.paid: Thank you. The order is paid, and this page follows it from here.
order.keep: Keep this link. It is the only way back to your order.
order.unknown.title: No order has this link.
order.unknown.body: Check that the whole link was copied. Order links are long on purpose.
visit.lede: The roastery's counter in Bergen. Beans over the counter, a till of its own, and somewhere dry for a few minutes.
visit.loose.title: Dark espresso, by the gram
visit.loose.body: At the counter the Dark espresso is sold loose, weighed out by the gram: as much as the week needs, or a little to try.
visit.loose.link: Dark espresso in the web shop
visit.club.title: The club
visit.club.body: The counter keeps a club of its own, run from the till. Ask about it when you are in.
visit.till.title: Its own till
visit.till.body: The counter has its own till. What you buy there is paid there, apart from the web shop.
lost.body: The link may be old or mistyped. The shop is still here.
